events.event: The Public Service Commission approves a three-year Con Edison electric rate plan for April 2010 to March 2013.
events.quote: The Joint Proposal, which was approved in March 2010, covers the three-year period April 2010 through March 2013
events.event_source_summary: PSC approves CECONY electric rate plan Apr 2010-Mar 2013 ($420M/$420M/$287M)

events.event: The state Department of Environmental Conservation adopts the “peaker rule,” limiting nitrogen oxide emissions from older peaking power plants, many of them in the city.
events.quote: In 2019, the New York State Department of Environmental Conservation issued regulations (Peaker Rule)
events.note: Exact DEC adoption date not taken from a DEC source.
events.event_source_summary: DEC issues Peaker Rule (NOx limits on older peaking units, ~1,700 MW nameplate in CECONY territory)

events.event: Indian Point Unit 2, a nuclear reactor in Westchester, shuts down.
events.quote: In April 2020, one of the two nuclear reactors at the Indian Point Energy Center (which is owned by Entergy Corporation subsidiaries) was shut down
events.note: Exact day not stated in source.

events.event: Indian Point’s last reactor, Unit 3, closes.
events.quote: will be closed, as planned, on Friday, April 30. The 2,000-megawatt nuclear power plant, located 24 miles north of New York City

events.event: The commission approves National Grid’s gas rate plan for Brooklyn, Staten Island, Queens and Long Island, April 2020 to March 2023, with no delivery increase in the first year.
events.quote: customers will experience no delivery rate increases in the first year
events.event_source_summary: PSC approves KEDNY/KEDLI gas rate plan (Apr 2020-Mar 2023), no delivery increase in year 1

events.event: With winter supply prices up sharply, the governor and the commission press Con Edison over its billing.
events.quote: resulting in a significant increase — sometimes more than doubling - of the supply component of customer electric and/or natural gas bills
events.event_source_summary: Winter 2021-22 supply price spike; PSC letter to Con Ed on billing practices

events.event: A state court rules that Con Edison is not entitled to a $1.3 billion refund of New York City property taxes on its “special franchise” property, for tax years 2013–14 to 2016–17.
events.quote: Con Edison was not entitled to a $1.3 billion property tax refund from the City.
events.note: Ruling issued Nov. 21, 2022 (Law Department release dated Nov. 22); verified on nyc.gov 2026-10-30.
events.event_source_summary: Court rules Con Ed not entitled to $1.3B NYC property tax refund (special franchise, tax years 2013/14-2016/17)

events.event: The commission adopts Con Edison’s electric and gas rate plan for 2023 to 2025.
events.quote: the Commission approved a levelized electric rate increase of $457.5 million for each of the three rate years
events.event_source_summary: PSC adopts CECONY 2023-2025 electric/gas rate plan

events.event: The commission adopts National Grid’s downstate gas rate plan for September 2024 through March 2027.
events.quote: the Commission approved a first-year delivery revenue increase of $404 million
events.event_source_summary: PSC adopts KEDNY/KEDLI 2024-2027 gas rate plan

events.event: Con Edison files new electric and gas rate cases (Cases 25-E-0072 and 25-G-0073).
events.quote: Con Edison filed amendments for new rates on January 31, 2025
events.event_source_summary: Con Ed files electric and gas rate cases (25-E-0072 / 25-G-0073)

events.event: A further 709 megawatts of older peaking plants are expected to go offline under the peaker rule; the grid operator may keep 672 megawatts running until May 2027 for reliability.
events.quote: An additional 709 MW (in nameplate capacity) of peaker plants were expected to become unavailable beginning May 1, 2025.
events.event_source_summary: Additional 709 MW of Peaker Rule units expected to become unavailable; NYISO may retain 672 MW until May 2027

events.event: The commission expands its energy affordability discounts to more households with incomes below the state median.
events.quote: The Commission expects the new program will help up to 1.6 million new households below median income qualify for benefits
events.event_source_summary: PSC adopts Enhanced Energy Affordability Policy (below-median-income discounts)

events.event: During the federal government shutdown, the commission bars utilities from dropping households from bill-discount programs.
events.quote: On November 13, 2025, at the urging of Governor Kathy Hochul, the Commission paused customer disenrollments in utility Energy Affordability Programs
events.event_source_summary: PSC pauses EAP disenrollments during federal shutdown (emergency order)

events.event: After the grid operator warns of a power-supply shortfall in the city, the commission orders Con Edison to prepare a reliability contingency plan (Case 25-E-0764).
events.quote: identified reliability needs arising as early as next year in New York City and Long Island
events.event_source_summary: PSC directs Con Ed to develop NYC Reliability Contingency Plan (Case 25-E-0764) after NYISO shortfall warning

events.event: The commission adopts Con Edison’s electric and gas rate plan for 2026 to 2028, with a 9.4% allowed return on equity.
events.quote: The adopted joint proposal will result in electric revenue requirement increases of $234 million in the first year
events.event_source_summary: PSC adopts CECONY 2026-2028 electric/gas rate plan (ROE 9.40%)

events.event: The commission extends the freeze on dropping households from bill-discount programs through Nov. 30, 2026.
events.quote: were directed on an emergency basis to pause EAP disenrollments through November 30, 2026
events.event_source_summary: PSC makes EAP disenrollment freeze final (through Nov 30, 2026)

events.event: The Champlain Hudson Power Express, a 1,250-megawatt line carrying power from Québec to Astoria, Queens, is completed.
events.quote: the 339-mile Champlain Hudson Power Express (CHPE), one of New York’s largest transmission infrastructure projects in 50 years, can now deliver
events.event_source_summary: Champlain Hudson Power Express completed (1,250 MW HVDC to Astoria, Queens)

events.event: The Department of Public Service forecasts statewide winter supply costs of about $74 a month for a 600 kWh customer, 4.6% more than a year earlier.
events.quote: An average residential electric customer using 600 kWh of electricity per month is expected to pay about $74 per month for supply
events.note: Page undated; read 2026-10-30. Statewide, not Con Ed-specific.
